description: Figure: R2 paralog iron ligand patterns across post-WGD and pre-WGD yeasts
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
res=pd.read_csv("prov/sacch_paralog_ligand_patterns.csv")
res["wgd"]=np.where(res.group.str.contains("WGD\\)")& ~res.group.str.contains("pre-WGD"),"post-WGD","pre-WGD / outgroup")
res=res.sort_values(["wgd","group","n_cons"])
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,7),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.5,1]})
ax=axes[0]
labels=[f"{g.split(' (')[0]}  {a}{(' '+gn) if isinstance(gn,str) and gn else ''}" for g,a,gn in zip(res.group,res.acc,res.gene)]
ypos=np.arange(len(res))[::-1]
cols=["#2166ac","#b2182b"]
for y,(pat,n) in zip(ypos,zip(res.ligand_pattern,res.n_cons)):
    for k,(obs,exp) in enumerate(zip(pat,"DEHEEH")):
        ok = obs==exp
        ax.text(k,y,obs,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=11,fontweight="bold",
                color="white",bbox=dict(boxstyle="square,pad=0.35",fc="#4daf4a" if ok else "#d73027",ec="none"))
for y,rt in zip(ypos,res.radTyr):
    ax.text(7,y,rt,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=11,fontweight="bold",color="white",
            bbox=dict(boxstyle="square,pad=0.35",fc="#4daf4a" if rt=="Y" else "#d73027",ec="none"))
ax.set_yticks(ypos); ax.set_yticklabels(labels,fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(list(range(6))+[7]); ax.set_xticklabels(["D145","E176","H179","E239","E273","H276","Y183\nradical"],fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlim(-0.7,7.7); ax.set_ylim(-0.8,len(res)-0.2)
ax.set_title("Iron ligands and radical Tyr of every R2-family paralog\nin post-WGD and pre-WGD yeasts (positions by alignment to S. cerevisiae Rnr2)",fontsize=10)
for s in ["top","right","bottom","left"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
ax2=axes[1]
ax2.scatter(res.pct_id_Rnr2,res.len,c=np.where(res.n_cons==6,"#4daf4a","#d73027"),s=70,edgecolor="k",zorder=3)
for _,r in res.iterrows():
    if r.n_cons<6: ax2.annotate(r.group.split(" (")[0],(r.pct_id_Rnr2,r["len"]),fontsize=7,xytext=(4,-3),textcoords="offset points")
ax2.set_xlabel("percent identity to S. cerevisiae Rnr2"); ax2.set_ylabel("protein length (aa)")
ax2.set_title("Degenerate paralogs (red) are shorter and more divergent;\nintact paralogs (green) cluster at 68-86 percent identity",fontsize=10)
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(res.groupby(["wgd"]).apply(lambda g: pd.Series({"n_paralogs":len(g),"n_with_degenerate_site":int((g.n_cons<6).sum())})).to_string())
